title: Novel diazenyl chalcones with a 2-arylidene hydrazineylidene thiazole moiety: synthesis, anticancer potential, spectroscopic characterisation, and molecular docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3894-3908
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07769A, Paper

Mariem M. El-Samoly, Esmail M. El-Fakharany, Yousra A. El-Maradny, Abdallah E. Abdallah, F. A. Taher, Nadia T. A. Dawoud, Doaa R. Lotfy
A series of diazenyl chalcones bearing 2-arylidene-hydrazinylidene thiazole units (4–6a,b) were designed, synthesised, and fully characterised by NMR, IR, MS, and UV spectroscopy.
